arguments.sql:
WITH eligible_rnp AS (
    SELECT l.ID, l.RNP, CAST(l.RNP AS INTEGER) AS titer
    FROM main.Laboratory AS l
    JOIN main.Patient AS p ON p.ID = l.ID
    WHERE p.Admission = '-'
      AND l.RNP <> 'negative'
      AND l.ID IN (
          SELECT s.ID
          FROM main.Laboratory AS s
          WHERE s.SSA NOT IN ('negative', '0')
      )
)
SELECT DISTINCT ID, RNP
FROM eligible_rnp
WHERE titer = (SELECT MAX(titer) FROM eligible_rnp)
ORDER BY ID
LIMIT -1
